text: {"lessons":["Several trades were made after sharp account swings; I should follow a clear investment plan rather than react to one month’s performance.","Selling at a loss or buying more does not by itself make a trade sound; I should reassess each holding on its merits, not its average cost.","I sold a winner and added to a stock more than once, so I should avoid letting profit-taking or averaging down become automatic and keep risk spread across holdings."]}
